name: card
title: Card
description: A shared content surface with measured padding, headers and footers. Compose it from the same controls as the rest of your product.
example:
<Card variant="bordered">
  <CardHeader title="Project details" description="The work behind the next release." />
  <Progress label="Tasks completed" value={72} />
  <CardFooter><Button>Open project</Button></CardFooter>
</Card>
